bibl.title: The Coptic ostraca of the Theban hermitage MMA 1152. 1. Letters (O. Gurna Górecki 12-68).
bibl.seg: Anne Boud'hors, The Coptic ostraca of the Theban hermitage MMA 1152. 1. Letters (O. Gurna Górecki 12-68).
bibl.note: O. Gurna Górecki 12-68. - During successive excavations carried on between 2003 and 2013 in the hermitage MMA 1152, Tomasz Górecki has dug out more than 300 ostraca and some fragments of Coptic papyri. Several letters were published in the previous years. In order to facilitate future references, the first numbers in a general numbering sequence were assigned to these published pieces [O. Gurna Górecki 1-8 = Esther Garel, The Ostraca of Victor the Priest Found in the Hermitage MMA 1152, Proceedings of the 27th International Congress of Papyrology, Warsaw, 29 July - 3 August 2013. Volume II. Subliterary Papyri, Documentary Papyri, Scribal Practices, Linguistic Matters = The Journal of Juristic Papyrology. Supplements. Volume XXVIII (Warsaw, 2016) pp. 1041-1054, figg; - 9 = Chantal Heurtel, Un nouvel exemple de l'activité de scribe du prêtre Marc à Thèbes, Études coptes XIII. Quinzième journée d'études (Louvain-la-Neuve, 12-14 mai 2011) = Collections de l'Université de Strasbourg. Études d'archéologie et d'histoire ancienne. Cahiers de la Bibliothèque copte. 20 (Paris, 2015) pp. 121-126, fig.; - 10-11 = Iwona Antoniak, New Ostraka from Thebes, Gawdat Gabra & Hany N. Takla (edd.), Christianity and Monasticism in Upper Egypt. Volume 2. Nag Hammadi-Esna (Cairo - New York, 2010) pp. 1-6, figg.].
